papers.title: ReScene: Structured Indoor Scene Reconstruction from Multi-View Captures
papers.authors: Haoran Xu, Lechao Zhang, Daoguo Dong, Yan Gao, Xin Tan
papers.affiliations: School of Computer Science and Technology, East China Normal University（Haoran Xu, Lechao Zhang, Yan Gao, Xin Tan），Institute of Trustworthy Embodied AI, Fudan University（Daoguo Dong）
papers.intro: ReScene是一个以多视图几何为统一先验的结构化室内场景重建框架，通过层次化视图选择（HierView）和关系感知组装（Relation-Aware Assembly），首次实现了从多视角视频到物体级、物理一致3D场景的端到端流水线。

papers.title: AirGroundBench: Probing Spatial Intelligence in Multimodal Large Models under Heterogeneous Multi-View Embodied Collaboration
papers.authors: Haotian Li, Yida Wang, Leyuan Wang, Jinshan Lai, Keyang Wang, Zonghao Guo, Qiang Ma, Liuyu Xiang, Jianwei Hu, Zhaofeng He
papers.affiliations: 北京邮电大学、启元实验室、清华大学、电子科技大学（具体对应关系见第十二部分）
papers.intro: 本文提出AirGroundBench，一个针对异构空地协作多视图空间智能的诊断基准，通过对13个代表MLLM的评估，揭示了模型在跨视图对齐和变换推理方面的系统性瓶颈。

papers.title: EMOSH: Expressive Motion and Shape Disentanglement for Human Animation
papers.authors: Dongbin Zhang, Hao Liu, Binquan Dai, Kangjie Chen, Chuming Wang, Chen Li, Jing Lyu, Haoqian Wang
papers.affiliations: Tsinghua Shenzhen International Graduate School, Tsinghua University; WeChat Vision, Tencent Inc
papers.intro: 提出EMOSH框架，利用表达性人体模型（EHM）作为核心控制表示，通过显式解耦形状和姿态参数，结合从粗到细的混合运动注入和空间对齐条件机制，实现高保真、表达性可控的人类视频生成，同时解决形状泄露问题。

papers.title: Enhancing Brain MRI Anomaly Detection and Reasoning with ROI Rethink and Synthetic Data
papers.authors: Shangkun Li, Jie Xu, Yi Guo, Zeju Li, Yuanyuan Wang
papers.affiliations: College of Biomedical Engineering, Fudan University
papers.intro: 本文提出BrReMark框架，通过引入“假设-标记-验证”的两轮交互推理和基于域随机化的病理合成增强，显著提升了脑MRI异常定位的准确性、诊断推理的可审计性以及模型在分布外数据上的鲁棒性。

papers.title: USS: Unified Spatial-Semantic Prompts for Embodied Visual Tracking with Latent Dynamics Learning
papers.authors: Yuchen Xie, Xinyu Zhou, Kuangji Zuo, Yanshuo Lu, Fengrui Huang, Boyu Ma, Jianfei Yang
papers.affiliations: Nanyang Technological University
papers.intro: 本文提出USS框架，将具身视觉跟踪的目标指示从纯文本扩展到统一的空间-语义提示（包括文本、点、边界框、掩码），通过端到端策略和潜在动力学学习实现更精确、灵活的实例级目标跟踪。

papers.title: Edges Before Embeddings: A Confidence-Aware Blur Gate for Vision-Language Pipelines
papers.authors: Duy Tran Thanh
papers.affiliations: Seoul National University of Science and Technology (SeoulTech) / OneMount Group
papers.intro: 本文提出MagikaDocumentFromPixel，一种基于MobileNetV3-Large和边缘先验模块（EPM）的轻量级模糊门控，在约7ms CPU推理时间内将图像分类为清晰、模糊或不确定，通过置信感知路由避免下游流水线处理无用输入。

papers.title: $S^{2}$-FracMix: Label-Preserving Self-Saliency Mixup Augmentation
papers.authors: Khawar Islam, Arif Mahmood, Xin Jin, Naveed Akhtar
papers.affiliations: The University of Melbourne, Australia; Information Technology University, Pakistan; Westlake University, China
papers.intro: 本文提出S2-FracMix，一种自显著性引导的多尺度补丁混合与局部分形注入相结合的数据增强框架，在保持标签一致性的同时提高样本多样性和结构复杂度，在多个视觉任务上取得了最先进的性能。

papers.title: Uncertainty Quantification for Computer-Use Agents: A Benchmark across Vision-Language Models and GUI Grounding Datasets
papers.authors: Divake Kumar, Sina Tayebati, Devashri Naik, Amanda Sofie Rios, Nilesh Ahuja, Omesh Tickoo, Ranganath Krishnan, Amit Ranjan Trivedi
papers.affiliations: University of Illinois Chicago (Divake Kumar, Sina Tayebati, Devashri Naik, Amit Ranjan Trivedi); Intel Labs (Amanda Sofie Rios, Nilesh Ahuja, Omesh Tickoo); Capital One AI Labs (Ranganath Krishnan)
papers.intro: 本文提出ARGUS，一个跨体制（cross-regime）的后验不确定性量化（UQ）基准，用于单步可执行GUI接地，系统评估27种方法在4个VLM代理和4个数据集上的排名转移性，发现UQ排名在固定模型下跨数据集稳定，但跨模型类和可观察接口退化。

papers.title: Dual Distribution Estimation for Zero-shot Noisy Test-Time Adaptation with VLMs
papers.authors: Wenjie Zhu, Yabin Zhang, Liang Xu, Xin Jin, Wenjun Zeng, Lei Zhang
papers.affiliations: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University, Eastern Institute of Technology, Ningbo, Harbin Institute of Technology (Shenzhen), Shanghai Jiao Tong University
papers.intro: 提出Dual Distribution Estimation（DDE）框架，通过正特征分布估计和负标签分布估计两个训练自由的高斯分布建模模块，将零样本NTTA从实例级学习范式转变为分布建模范式，在ImageNet上同时提升谐波平均准确率3.70%并降低OOD检测FPR95达6.20%。

papers.title: Point Cloud Diffusion with Global and Local Reconstruction for Instance-Level 3D Anomaly Detection
papers.authors: Linchun Wu, Qin Zou, Jiwen Lu, Qingquan Li
papers.affiliations: 武汉大学、清华大学、广东人工智能与数字经济实验室（深圳）
papers.intro: 提出PCDiff，一个统一的点云扩散框架，通过多模态条件生成细粒度异常并结合局部‑全局联合重建，显著提升实例级3D异常检测的准确性和鲁棒性。

papers.title: UniTeD: Unified Temporal Diffusion for Joint Perception and Planning in Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Bo Zhao, Xinting Zhao, Naifan Li, Erkang Cheng, Haibin Ling
papers.affiliations: Nullmax, Westlake University
papers.intro: UniTeD 是一个统一的时间扩散框架，通过共享生成空间中的迭代去噪同时建模感知和规划任务，并引入时间过渡模块和锚点刷新策略来解决时序不匹配和训练-推理分布偏移问题，在多个基准上取得最优性能。

papers.title: Efficient Real-World Dehazing via Physics-Inspired Global-Local Decoupling
papers.authors: Yifei Qu, Ru Li, Junjie Chen, Jinyuan Wu
papers.affiliations: Faculty of Computing, Harbin Institute of Technology, Harbin 150006, China
papers.intro: 论文提出一种轻量级物理启发式全局-局部解耦网络（PGL-Net），通过算子级模拟嵌入物理归纳偏置，将去雾解耦为全局分布校正和局部结构精化，在多个真实世界基准上达到最先进恢复质量并显著降低计算复杂度。

papers.title: Falcon: Functional Assembly and Language for Compositional Reasoning in X-ray
papers.authors: Yonathan Michael, Mohamad Alansari, Natnael Takele, Andreas Henschel, Naoufel Werghi
papers.affiliations: Khalifa University (Computer Science Department, Center of Cyber-physical Systems)
papers.intro: 本文提出Falcon，一个多模态框架，通过将分割感知的区域特征抽象为包含组件存在、成对功能兼容性和场景风险的显式安全状态，并注入语言模型，实现X-ray图像中关系一致的结构化组合威胁推理。

papers.title: DiffusionBench: On Holistic Evaluation of Diffusion Transformers
papers.authors: Xingjian Leng, Jaskirat Singh, Zhanhao Liang, Ethan Smith, Martin Bell, Aninda Saha, Yuhui Yuan, Liang Zheng
papers.tags: image generation, diffusion model, vision transformer
papers.affiliations: Australian National University, Canva Research
papers.intro: 本文提出统一DiT训练框架NanoGen，证明ImageNet FID与T2I性能无强相关性，并构建结合两类任务的DiffusionBench基准，建议未来DiT研究应报告该基准而非仅ImageNet结果。

papers.title: FLAT: Feedforward Latent Triangle Splatting for Geometrically Accurate Scene Generation
papers.authors: Orest Kupyn, Goutam Bhat, Philipp Henzler, Fabian Manhardt, Christian Rupprecht, Federico Tombari
papers.affiliations: Google Research, University of Oxford (Visual Geometry Group), TU Munich
papers.intro: FLAT首次实现了从视频扩散潜在中直接解码非体积三角形泼溅基元，通过射线中心局部参数化和乘积窗口函数稳定训练，在保持竞争性视觉质量的同时显著提升几何精度，并支持轻量级测试时优化以转换为游戏引擎兼容的完全不透明表示。

papers.title: IV-CoT: Implicit Visual Chain-of-Thought for Structure-Aware Text-to-Image Generation
papers.authors: Zixuan Li, Haokun Lin, Yicheng Xiao, Zhiwei Li, Xinyang Song, Zelong Zheng, Yong He, Heng Yao, Ke Ding, Chao Yu, Chuan Yuan, Qi Li, Zhenan Sun
papers.affiliations: 1NLPR, Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences；2Ant Group；3The University of Hong Kong
papers.intro: 本文提出隐式视觉链式推理（IV-CoT），通过结构到语义的查询级联和仅训练阶段的草图监督，使MLLM-DiT生成器在一个前向传播中内部完成潜在视觉规划，从而在不提取草图或解码中间图像的情况下显著提升结构感知的提示遵循能力。

papers.title: Bridging the Manifold Gap: Riemannian Residual Line Search for One-Step Image Editing
papers.authors: Hongzhu Yi, Zhongtian Luo, Tong Li, Yiyan Fan, Jungang Xu
papers.affiliations: Hongzhu Yi - UCAS, Zhongtian Luo - UCAS, Tong Li - WashU, Yiyan Fan - SHU, Jungang Xu - UCAS
papers.intro: 本文提出黎曼残差线搜索（RRLS）方法，通过联合一阶与二阶差分近似来估计能量场的局部时间曲率，并构造残差候选路径结合正则化选择，在不增加推理步数的情况下，在一系列一步编辑方法中实现了最优的编辑质量与保真度权衡。

papers.title: GeoT2V-Bench: Benchmarking 3D Consistency in Text-to-Video Models via 3D Reconstruction
papers.authors: Chenrui Fan, Paolo Favaro
papers.affiliations: University of Bern, Switzerland
papers.intro: 提出GeoT2V-Bench，一个基于重建的诊断基准，通过先拟合灵活的可变形高斯表示（DeformableGS）再提取静态代理（MedianGS）的两阶段方法，对相机提示的T2V视频进行连续重建剖面评估，揭示其作为静态场景采集的证据质量。

papers.title: High-Fidelity Synthetic Transmission Electron Microscopy Image Generation Using Diffusion Probabilistic Models for Data-Limited Semiconductor Metrology
papers.authors: Johannes Boehm, Bappaditya Dey
papers.affiliations: Chemnitz University of Technology, Germany; Interuniversity Microelectronics Centre (imec), Leuven, Belgium
papers.intro: 提出一种基于去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）的生成框架，通过渐进式补丁训练策略（从64×64到1024×1024分辨率）和定制化数据增强，在仅15张真实图像的极端数据稀缺条件下，生成高保真、符合FAB计量规范的合成TEM图像，并进一步利用DDPM中间特征实现无监督分割。

papers.title: DDStereo: Efficient Dual Decoder Transformers for Stereo 3D Road Anomaly Detection
papers.authors: Shiyi Mu, Zichong Gu, Zhiqi Ai, Yilin Gao, Shugong Xu
papers.affiliations: 上海大学(Shiyi Mu, Zichong Gu, Zhiqi Ai, Yilin Gao), 西交利物浦大学(Shugong Xu)
papers.intro: 提出DDStereo，一种双解码器Transformer立体3D检测框架，通过解耦前景定位（基于视差）和3D属性回归（基于左视图），共享对象查询实现对齐，首次达到单目级推理速度（23.5ms），在闭集和开集基准上均取得SOTA。
